summary: The naive removal of the one-sided square/rank-two isolation by rank-two Plancherel followed by a uniform one-parameter Gabor-line L2 restriction is false. For any nonzero kappa, cap-one probability-amplitude moduli b_L,h_L with quadratic chirps give T(z)=(L-|z|)_+/L^2, so int|T|^2=2/(3L) while ||b||_2^2||h||_2^2=1/L^2; the ratio diverges. This refutes only that intermediate line-restriction interface, not QFORM and not the target-wide L1 characteristic-function criterion. The same report switches mechanism and proves a full q>2 shifted-square Fourier family and a logarithmic near-isotropic one-sided packet bound.
